repos_data.description: 本地运行的A股/美股多策略选股、模拟交易与风控提醒工作台｜Local-first and read-only

Interactive Brokers, curl-friendly — over REST + MCP. FastAPI + ib_async over a Linux-native IB Gateway: stocks/options/futures/forex/crypto/CFD contracts, quotes, historical bars, orders, positions, executions. Typed MCP tools mirror the whole surface. The IBKR half of mt5-httpapi — same shape, no Windows VM.
